notes.title: Full Release! Now Available for Play!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello! This is Buff Studio.

We are excited to announce the official release of <Skel Dungeon: Heroes Must Die!>.[/h3]

[h1]🎉<Skel Dungeon: Heroes Must Die!> Full Release on 10/22 (KST)🎉[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056989/e98417f6c021c257b61987a200e074842ac05aa1.png[/img]

In the official release version, you can enjoy 7 stages and an infinite mode, along with a storyline where you can resurrect the Demon King!

Thank you for all the attention and feedback since the demo version. Thanks to your input, Skel Dungeon has become even more fun!

If you’re eager to create your own dungeon and trap heroes, start playing Skel Dungeon now!

🎁[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2963830/Skel_Dungeon/][Play the Official Release Version][/url]
